summary: Follow-up cleanup verification for the share-buttons bug fix on /events/evt-festival-2026. Confirmed that the legacy popup code and 3 redundant ActionButton tiles have been fully removed from /pages/EventDetail.jsx, and the new one-tap ShareButtons row still works end-to-end. Source grep: `noopener,noreferrer,width` — 0 matches across /app/frontend/src; `openPopup|shareToFacebook|shareToWhatsApp|buildWhatsAppText` — 0 matches; `MessageCircle` import in EventDetail.jsx — 0 matches (fully purged). UI verification: (a) the ActionButton grid under 'Promote this event' now contains EXACTLY 3 tiles — 'Copy Facebook Post', 'Copy Poster Link', 'Download Calendar File'; (b) the 3 legacy labels 'Share to Facebook', 'Share on WhatsApp', 'Copy Event Link' are absent from the entire rendered page; (c) the 'One-tap share' row above renders all 6 ShareButtons (share-facebook, share-linkedin, share-twitter, share-whatsapp, share-instagram, share-copy). Behaviour verification via window.open interception: Facebook → `https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=<encoded event URL>` (no quote param), LinkedIn → `share-offsite/?url=<encoded>`, X/Twitter → `intent/tweet?text=<encoded caption>&url=<encoded>`, WhatsApp → `wa.me/?text=<encoded caption+url>` — all with target=_blank and features=null (i.e. no deprecated `noopener,noreferrer,width,height` string). Clipboard tiles: 'Copy Facebook Post' fires Sonner toast 'Facebook post copied'; 'Copy Poster Link' fires 'Poster image link copied'. 'Download Calendar File' triggered a real download event with suggested_filename='evt-festival-2026.ics'. OrgDashboard ParsedCard ShareButtons regression: /components/ShareButtons.jsx is byte-identical to iteration_4 and the OrgDashboard import/usage (line 389 of OrgDashboard.jsx) is unchanged, so the iteration_4 pass still holds.
critical_code_review_comments: EventDetail.jsx line 27–30: `SITE_ORIGIN` is derived from window.location.origin at module-eval time. This is fine for a browser build but means the constant is captured once when the module is first imported. If the module is ever imported in an SSR/prerender context the fallback string `https://rodlife.co.uk` will leak — consider moving to inside the component or reading from an env var (REACT_APP_SITE_URL).

P3 (from iteration_4, still applicable): OG/Twitter tags in /public/index.html remain static site-level, so Facebook/LinkedIn crawlers of /events/<id> URLs will still see the generic site image/title. Per-event previews would need SSR or a small backend HTML endpoint that injects per-event og tags — main agent already flagged this as out-of-scope for this bug fix.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all cleanup checks pass, all 6 share buttons open correct URLs with no deprecated features string, all 3 remaining ActionButton tiles fire correct toast/download.
